# Input declarations and resolution

<!-- Generated by scripts/core_docs.py; edit the source of truth and regenerate. -->

Declare parameters on a strategy class, then discover and inject values by unique title. Definitions, resolution, and runtime values are managed separately.

[Usage guide](../guides/inputs.md) · [Compatibility and internal entries](classification.md)

<a id="openbacktesting-inputs-inputerror"></a>

## InputError

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.inputs.InputError`

```python
openbacktesting.inputs.InputError(code, title, expected, value=None)
```

Parameter error that callers can display using code/title/expected/actual_type.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/strategy/inputs.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-inputs-inputspec"></a>

## InputSpec

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.inputs.InputSpec`

```python
openbacktesting.inputs.InputSpec(kind: 'str', title: 'str', default: 'object', options: 'tuple | None' = None, bounds: 'tuple' = (), metadata: 'tuple' = (), enum_type: 'type[Enum] | None' = None, bindings: 'tuple' = ()) -> None
```

Immutable strategy class-field declaration created by inputs factories; instance reads return this run's value.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/strategy/inputs.py`。

Fields are extracted from definitions; constructor signatures show defaults. See the corresponding guide for field semantics.

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `kind` | `str` |
| `title` | `str` |
| `default` | `object` |
| `options` | `tuple \| None` |
| `bounds` | `tuple` |
| `metadata` | `tuple` |
| `enum_type` | `type[Enum] \| None` |
| `bindings` | `tuple` |

<a id="openbacktesting-inputs-inputspec-encode"></a>

### encode

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.inputs.InputSpec.encode`

```python
openbacktesting.inputs.InputSpec.encode(self, value)
```

Encode normalized value into configuration form; enums use member names, and colors use uppercase eight-digit strings.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/strategy/inputs.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-inputs-inputspec-export"></a>

### export

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.inputs.InputSpec.export`

```python
openbacktesting.inputs.InputSpec.export(self, attribute)
```

Export the declaration dictionary; attribute is the Python field name, while configuration associations use unique title.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/strategy/inputs.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-inputs-inputspec-normalize"></a>

### normalize

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.inputs.InputSpec.normalize`

```python
openbacktesting.inputs.InputSpec.normalize(self, value, *, wire=False)
```

Validate and normalize value; wire=True parses enums from their serialized form, and invalid values raise InputError.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/strategy/inputs.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-inputs-resolvedinputs"></a>

## ResolvedInputs

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.inputs.ResolvedInputs`

```python
openbacktesting.inputs.ResolvedInputs(schema_hash: 'str', runtime: 'tuple', encoded: 'tuple', overridden: 'tuple', attributes: 'tuple') -> None
```

Validated input-resolution result containing the declaration digest, runtime values, encoded values, and explicitly overridden titles.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/strategy/inputs.py`。

Fields are extracted from definitions; constructor signatures show defaults. See the corresponding guide for field semantics.

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `schema_hash` | `str` |
| `runtime` | `tuple` |
| `encoded` | `tuple` |
| `overridden` | `tuple` |
| `attributes` | `tuple` |

<a id="openbacktesting-inputs-resolvedinputs-overrides"></a>

### overrides

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.inputs.ResolvedInputs.overrides`

```python
openbacktesting.inputs.ResolvedInputs.overrides(self)
```

Return explicitly overridden Python fields and values for injection into strategy instances.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/strategy/inputs.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-inputs-resolvedinputs-snapshot"></a>

### snapshot

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.inputs.ResolvedInputs.snapshot`

```python
openbacktesting.inputs.ResolvedInputs.snapshot(self)
```

Return a snapshot of version, declaration digest, complete values, and explicitly overridden titles for result attrs.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/strategy/inputs.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-inputs-schema-version"></a>

## SCHEMA_VERSION

Schema version used for input discovery and requests.

`openbacktesting.inputs.SCHEMA_VERSION` = `1.0.0`。

<a id="openbacktesting-inputs-bool"></a>

## bool

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.inputs.bool`

```python
openbacktesting.inputs.bool(kind, defval, *, title, tooltip='', group='', inline='', display=None, active=True, confirm=False, options=<object object>, minval=<object object>, maxval=<object object>, step=<object object>)
```

Declare read-only strategy configuration fields; inputs.bool/int/float and other entry points bind the kind.

Args:
    defval: Default value matching the declared kind.
    title: Required and unique within one strategy; also the title-based configuration key.
    tooltip: Hint text.
    group: Display group, without changing title uniqueness scope.
    inline: Hint for display on the same row.
    display: all/none/status_line/data_window; metadata only.
    active: Boolean constant or mapping referencing a bool parameter title; does not bypass value validation.
    confirm: Confirmation-hint metadata, without opening a UI.
    options: Allowed-value set; numeric kinds cannot also specify bounds or step.
    minval: Numeric lower bound for int/float only.
    maxval: Numeric upper bound for int/float only.
    step: Adjustment increment, not a divisibility constraint; int/float only.

Returns:
    InputSpec: Class-field descriptor; instance reads return this run's resolved value.

Raises:
    InputError: Invalid declaration, default, parameter domain, or display metadata.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/strategy/inputs.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-inputs-request-for"></a>

## request_for

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.inputs.request_for`

```python
openbacktesting.inputs.request_for(strategy_class, kwargs)
```

Convert Python field kwargs for a declared strategy_class into a title-based request; first confirm the class contains Input; invalid values raise InputError.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/strategy/inputs.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-inputs-resolve-native"></a>

## resolve_native

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.inputs.resolve_native`

```python
openbacktesting.inputs.resolve_native(strategy_class, kwargs)
```

Native field entry point; undeclared classes return None to preserve legacy behavior.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/strategy/inputs.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-inputs-resolve-request"></a>

## resolve_request

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.inputs.resolve_request`

```python
openbacktesting.inputs.resolve_request(strategy_class, request)
```

Validate request version, digest, and title values against strategy_class; failures raise InputError, and success returns ResolvedInputs.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/strategy/inputs.py`。
